Welcome! I'm so glad you're joining me for this journey, where we unravel one of the most powerful stories of our time.
Imagine a century-long battle that’s shaped not just policies, but entire societies—and touched countless lives, all in the quest to end the spread of drugs.
That’s the world we step into with Johann Hari’s eye-opening book, Chasing the Scream: The First and Last Days of the War on Drugs.
Together, we’ll meet the people who live at the heart of this story—those struggling with addiction, those trying to enforce the law, those caught dealing, and even the bold reformers pushing for change.
What if, behind every headline or statistic, there’s a deeply personal human cost?
As we explore these tangled roots and the far-reaching effects of the global war on drugs, you’ll see how it’s not just a simple tale of good versus evil. Instead, it’s a complicated, deeply human struggle—where pain, hope, and resilience are always intertwined.
We’ll travel from the very origins of prohibition right up to today, and along the way, we’ll witness how the relentless drive for a drug-free world has led to some unintended and heartbreaking consequences: mass incarceration, fractured families, and the rise of powerful criminal networks.
Through these true stories and pivotal moments, there’s a thread that keeps coming back—a search for compassion and understanding that challenges everything we thought we knew about justice, addiction, and healing.
So, as we step into this journey together, let’s open ourselves to new perspectives and ask—what would it really take to end a war that’s touched every corner of our society?
